**Conclusion:** Ka8 is clearly best! It walks into Rb8+, after which either Kxb8 or Rxb8 wins White's rook for Black, gaining material decisively. The idea is that the trapped king on a8 forces White to give up the rook.

**Main line verification:** Ka8 Rb8+ (forced check) Kxb8 (or Rxb8), winning White's rook.

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent's king is trapped in a corner (here a8), check how forcing moves like Rb8+ work. The king cannot escape, so it must capture—and that capture can win material. Look for ways to attract the enemy king into an even tighter corner to force winning captures. This pattern appears whenever a king lacks escape squares.
